items.title: Introduction
items.description: A progressive Notes application: six foundation chapters and optional capabilities.

items.title: Ch 1: Hello Agent
items.description: Run one assistant, send a message and read its reply.

items.title: Ch 2: Your First Tool
items.description: Give the assistant one explicit, executable capability.

items.title: Ch 3: Application Data and Actions
items.description: Store notes and share one operation across agents and application callers.

items.title: Ch 4: Processors and Lifecycles
items.description: React to recorded changes and trace application execution.

items.title: Ch 5: Reusable Plugins
items.description: Package behavior once and compose it across applications.

items.title: Ch 6: Persistence and Recovery
items.description: Keep state across restarts and understand retry boundaries.

items.title: Ch 7: Existing APIs and Tools
items.description: Choose native, OpenAPI or MCP integration when a task needs it.

items.title: Ch 8: Skills
items.description: Package reusable instructions and grant access explicitly.

items.title: Ch 9: Agent Collaboration
items.description: Add a specialist, establish membership and enable public questions.

items.title: Ch 10: Memory and Knowledge
items.description: Distinguish conversation history, long-term memory and document retrieval.

items.title: Ch 11: HTTP and Client
items.description: Expose application Actions behind policy and call them from a typed client.

items.title: Ch 12: Interfaces and Channels
items.description: Connect a chat interface or another conversation transport.

items.title: Ch 13: Content and Usage
items.description: Separate large bodies from records and account for model work.

items.title: Ch 14: Tenants and Access
items.description: Choose data scope from authenticated identity and enforce access policy.

items.title: Ch 15: Deployment and Next Steps
items.description: Start embedded and choose Gateway/Worker placement when needed.
